text:
The most serious crime is murder. The defendant acted with intent to inflict serious bodily harm by firing a gun at another person, which shows a depraved-heart or extreme-recklessness mental state. Under transferred intent, that mental state carries over to the teammate who died, so this is murder rather than involuntary manslaughter. It isn't first-degree murder because there was no premeditated intent to kill.

CONFIDENCE: 72
